comment:
* Policy on when async requests are executed. * *

Each dispatcher uses an {@link ExecutorService} to run calls internally. If you * supply your own executor, it should be able to run {@linkplain #getMaxRequests the * configured maximum} number of calls concurrently. * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

variables.name: readyCalls
variables.comment: Ready calls in the order they'll be run.

variables.name: runningCalls
variables.comment: Running calls. Includes canceled calls that haven't finished yet.

variables.name: executedCalls
variables.comment: In-flight synchronous calls. Includes canceled calls that haven't finished yet.

methods.name: public synchronized void setMaxRequests(int maxRequests)
methods.comment:
* Set the maximum number of requests to execute concurrently. Above this * requests queue in memory, waiting for the running calls to complete. * *

If more than {@code maxRequests} requests are in flight when this is * invoked, those requests will remain in flight.

methods.name: public synchronized void setMaxRequestsPerHost(int maxRequestsPerHost)
methods.comment:
* Set the maximum number of requests for each host to execute concurrently. * This limits requests by the URL's host name. Note that concurrent requests * to a single IP address may still exceed this limit: multiple hostnames may * share an IP address or be routed through the same HTTP proxy. * *

If more than {@code maxRequestsPerHost} requests are in flight when this * is invoked, those requests will remain in flight.

methods.name: public synchronized void cancel(Object tag)
methods.comment: Cancel all calls with the tag {@code tag}.

methods.name: synchronized void finished(AsyncCall call)
methods.comment: Used by {@code AsyncCall#run} to signal completion.

methods.name: private int runningCallsForHost(AsyncCall call)
methods.comment: Returns the number of running calls that share a host with {@code call}.

methods.name: synchronized void executed(Call call)
methods.comment: Used by {@code Call#execute} to signal it is in-flight.

methods.name: synchronized void finished(Call call)
methods.comment: Used by {@code Call#execute} to signal completion.
